intro: Rio rewards visitors with dramatic scenery, lively neighbourhoods and a culture that never sits still. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro lines 1 and 2 are fast and safe; fares around R$4.70.
City buses are cheap (from R$4.70) but crowded; watch your belongings.
Taxis are metered; ride apps like Uber and 99 work well.
Driving is confusing with poor signage; parking is hard.
Walking is good in beach areas; bikes are popular along the coast.
Ferries (barcas) link Centro's Praça XV to Niterói.

christ_redeemer.price_text: Ticket price varies by season and transport option — check on the day
christ_redeemer.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–19:00; check on the day
christ_redeemer.tip: Go early morning for clearer skies and fewer crowds; clouds can hide the statue fast.

copacabana.name: Copacabana Beach
copacabana.tip: Walk the full 4 km promenade at sunrise; keep valuables minimal and watch your things.

ipanema.name: Ipanema Beach
ipanema.tip: Posto 9 is the lively stretch; sit near families at Posto 10 if you want it calmer.

maracana.hours: Tour times vary by match schedule; check on the day
maracana.tip: Book a stadium tour, or better, catch a Flamengo or Fluminense match if one is on.

cathedral.name: Metropolitan Cathedral of Saint Sebastian
cathedral.hours: Daily, roughly 07:00–17:00; check on the day
cathedral.tip: Step inside for the huge stained-glass windows and the cone-shaped ceiling.

selaron.name: Escadaria Selarón
selaron.tip: Come early morning for photos without crowds; the steps are slippery when wet.

aquario.name: AquaRio
aquario.price_text: Ticket price — check on the day
aquario.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–18:00; check on the day
aquario.tip: Good rainy-day option with kids; buy tickets online to skip the queue.

bobs.name: Bob's
bobs.price_text: Cheap burgers and shakes — check menu on the day
bobs.hours: Daily, long hours; check on the day
bobs.tip: Brazilian fast-food chain; handy cheap bite near Copacabana when you need a quick stop.

botanical_garden.name: Botanical Garden of Rio de Janeiro
botanical_garden.landmark: Botanical Garden of Rio de Janeiro
botanical_garden.price_text: Small entry fee — check on the day
botanical_garden.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–17:00; check on the day
botanical_garden.tip: Walk the palm avenue and look for toucans and monkeys in the morning.

candelaria.name: Candelaria Church
candelaria.hours: Weekdays, roughly 08:00–16:00; check on the day
candelaria.tip: Quiet colonial-era church in Centro; visit on a weekday and keep to the main streets.

feijoada.name: Feijoada lunch
feijoada.price_text: Plate around BRL 50–90 depending on the restaurant
feijoada.hours: Often served at lunch, especially Sat; check on the day
feijoada.tip: Try it at a traditional restaurant with rice, farofa and orange slices; it is heavy, so go hungry.

flamengo.name: Flamengo Beach
flamengo.tip: Best for a sunset walk along the bay with views of Sugarloaf; not the cleanest for swimming.

forte_copacabana.name: Fort of Copacabana
forte_copacabana.price_text: Small entry fee — check on the day
forte_copacabana.hours: Tue–Sun, roughly 10:00–18:00; check on the day
forte_copacabana.tip: Walk to the far end of Copacabana for great views back along the beach and out to sea.

guanabara_bay.name: Guanabara Bay
guanabara_bay.price_text: Free to view from the shore
guanabara_bay.tip: See the bay from Flamengo or Botafogo at sunset for the classic Rio skyline view.

bay_cruise.name: Guanabara Bay Cruise
bay_cruise.price_text: Tour price varies — check on the day
bay_cruise.tip: A boat trip gives you views of Sugarloaf and the city from the water; check weather before booking.

lapa_arches.name: Lapa Arches
lapa_arches.tip: Come at night for the samba bars nearby, or daytime for a quieter photo of the aqueduct.

leblon.name: Leblon Beach
leblon.tip: Quieter and more upscale than Ipanema; good for a relaxed walk and a beach kiosk drink.

museum_tomorrow.name: Museum of Tomorrow
museum_tomorrow.price_text: Ticket price — check on the day
museum_tomorrow.hours: Tue–Sun, roughly 10:00–18:00; check on the day
museum_tomorrow.tip: Striking waterfront building; go for the architecture and the harbour views even if you skip the exhibits.

niteroi_mac.name: Niteroi Contemporary Art Museum
niteroi_mac.price_text: Small entry fee — check on the day
niteroi_mac.hours: Tue–Sun, roughly 10:00–18:00; check on the day
niteroi_mac.tip: Take the ferry from Centro to Niteroi for the ride and the saucer-shaped museum on the cliff.

parque_lage.name: Parque Lage
parque_lage.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–17:00; check on the day
parque_lage.tip: Walk up behind the mansion for a framed view of Christ the Redeemer through the trees.

parque_shanghai.name: Parque Shanghai
parque_shanghai.hours: Daily, daytime; check on the day
parque_shanghai.tip: Small hilltop park near Flamengo with a fine view over Guanabara Bay; go at sunset.

santa_teresa_walk.name: Santa Teresa neighbourhood walk
santa_teresa_walk.price_text: Free to walk; tram ticket extra
santa_teresa_walk.hours: Daytime; check tram times on the day
santa_teresa_walk.tip: Wander the hilly streets and stop for coffee; ride the historic tram if it is running.

municipal_market.name: Mercado Municipal do Rio
municipal_market.price_text: Pay per item — check on the day
municipal_market.hours: Weekdays and Sat, daytime; check on the day
municipal_market.tip: Good stop for local snacks, fruit and coffee near the port area.

mirante_dona_marta.name: Mirante Dona Marta viewpoint
mirante_dona_marta.tip: A quieter alternative viewpoint with Christ the Redeemer and Sugarloaf in one frame.

favela_tour.name: Community-guided favela tour
favela_tour.price_text: Tour price varies — check on the day
favela_tour.tip: Choose a tour run by residents and check where the money goes before booking.

sunset_arpex.name: Sunset at Arpoador Rock
sunset_arpex.tip: Join locals on the rock between Ipanema and Copacabana to clap for the sunset.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Tijuca forest, Sugarloaf views and coastal walks.

stays.why: Classic beach base. Metro stations along the avenue, plenty of cheap eats and easy walks on the sand.
Nicer beach and better restaurants. Good for couples and first-time visitors who want to walk everywhere.
Central and well connected by metro. Close to Sugarloaf, Centro and nightlife in Lapa by taxi.
Cheapest and closest to museums and the ferry to Niterói. Quiet at night and weekends; check safety after dark.

food.tip: Try a feijoada lunch (black bean stew with pork) at a neighbourhood restaurant; portions are big, so share.
Eat at a kilo buffet (por quilo) for lunch: pay by weight and try many Brazilian dishes cheaply.
Grab a pão de queijo and a fresh juice from a corner padaria for breakfast.
Churrasco (grilled meat) rodízio restaurants are filling and popular; go hungry.
Beach vendors sell snacks and drinks. Carry small cash and keep your phone out of sight.

more_time.idea: Take the ferry (barca) from Praça XV to Niterói and see the Niemeyer museum and beaches.
